verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs say you can configure Snyk to ignore an issue and suppress specific warnings, which covers suppressing false positives. The evidence is a single thin mention scoped to Snyk Code, and nothing shows a baseline of existing findings or alerting limited to new issues. Missing for 10: baseline/snapshot of existing findings, new-issues-only alerting or gating, documented ignore workflows (expiry, reasons, scope across products), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert

citations.quote: Configure Snyk to ignore suggested fixes for an issue to suppress specific warnings.
